strings.흐르는 눈물을 닦으라며. 바람이 나와 그대를 스쳐 지나가네♪: The wind brushes past us, bidding our tears dry♪
strings.대지의 여신이여. 지나가는 바람을 붙잡아 주소서♬: Goddess of the earth, hold that passing wind♬
I know so few songs. I'm tired of singing the same ones over and over...
I don't mind. You sing so well, Jenna. I love listening.
%s, how long have you been there? I thought you were a ghost.
For a moment, I thought I'd misheard that.
Whew. My nerves have settled. Welcome, %s...
I came to see how you were doing.
Thank you for looking out for me...
strings.덕분에 오라버니도 만나 이야기할 수 있었어요. 소소한 것부터 최근 일까지: Thanks to you, I got to speak with my brother. About little things, and everything that's happened lately... It's all thanks to you, %s.
strings.아니에요. 그런데 이건 지스카드 님이 가져오신 건가 봐요?: It's nothing. Did Ziskad bring all of this?
strings.(제나 주위에 온갖 음식과 선물 상자가 놓여 있다.): (All kinds of food and gift boxes surround Jenna.)
strings.네, 제가 좋아했던 것들이에요. 비록 먹을 수도 없고, 손을 댈 수도 없: Yes. Things I used to love. I can't eat them or even touch them, but...
I'm happy because I can feel his affection.
strings.좋아보여서 다행이에요. 그런데, 노래가 맘에 안 드나봐요?: I'm glad you seem well. But you don't like the songs?
strings.몇 백 년째 같은 노래만 부르고 있으니 지겨워서요. 오라버니께 부탁드리려: I've been singing the same songs for hundreds of years. It's getting tiresome. I'd ask my brother, but he's so busy that I'd feel bad...
Wait a moment. That gives me an idea...
strings.혹시 악보를 구해다 드릴까요? 예전에 어떤 분이 가지고 계셨던 악보가 떠: Would you like me to find some sheet music? I remember someone who had some.
strings.아, 좋아요. 어렵지 않으면 보고 따라 부를 수 있긴 하거든요!: Oh, I'd love that. As long as it isn't too difficult, I can sing from the score!
strings.드리는 건 어렵지 않은데, 여러 장이면 어떻게 하죠? 넘기시는 게 좀 어: Getting it won't be a problem, but what if there are several pages? Turning them might be difficult.
strings.걱정 마세요. 제가 그동안 얌전한 알게아 몇 마리랑 친해졌거든요. 그 아: Don't worry. I've befriended a few gentle Algae. I'll recruit them to help!
strings.아하하, 그런 방법이 있군요. 그러면 제가 악보를 구해서 바로 영지로 돌: Ahaha. That's one way to do it. I'll find the sheet music and come straight back to the estate.
strings.이게 제가 말씀드린 그 악보에요. 잠깐 보시겠어요?: Here's the sheet music I mentioned. Would you take a look?
strings.아름다운 세레나데… 곡인 것 같아요!: I think it's a beautiful serenade!
strings.(내가 들었던 그 곡 맞아? 오로라 여왕이 불렀던 곡과 분명 멜로디는 같: (Is this really the song I heard? The melody's definitely the same as the one the Aurora Queen sang...)
The person who sang this must have held someone dear in her heart...
strings.잘 안 되셨나 보군요. 안타까워요. 이런 좋은 노래를 부르셨다면 잘 되셨: Things didn't work out, then? That's a shame. With such a lovely song, I'd have thought they would.
Things don't always turn out the way we hope.
Then let me sing it for you. I've changed the lyrics a little.
strings.(제나가 심호흡을 하더니 천천히 허밍을 시작한다. 맑고 고운 목소리가 영: (Jenna takes a deep breath and begins humming softly. Her clear, lovely voice spreads across the estate.)
strings.그토록 보고 싶던 사람이여♬: The one I've longed to see♬
strings.오랜 시간을 거슬러 이제 손을 잡고…♩: Across the years, at last we join hands...♩
strings.(영지에 있던 동물들이 행동을 멈추고 제나의 목소리에 반응하는 것이 눈에: (The animals on the estate visibly stop what they are doing and respond to Jenna's voice.)
Wow... I love the way you sing, Jenna.
strings.감사드려요. 모험가님께 꼭 들려드리고 싶었어요. 오라버니도 오시면 들려드: Thank you. I really wanted you to hear it. I'll sing it for my brother when he comes, too... Oh, I'd love Lady Gaia and Lady Iris to hear it as well...
strings.가이아 님은 잘 모르겠지만, 이리스한테는 가능할지도 몰라요. 아, 그런데: I'm not sure about Gaia, but Iris might be possible. Oh, but you can't leave this place.
strings.이건 제가 생전에 어머니께 들었던 이야기에요. 아니…. 정확히는 생전이: It's a story my mother told me when I was alive. Well... Not exactly when I was alive, I suppose.
Does that still bother you? They're your memories, whatever happened.
That's true... Thank you for caring.
strings.하여튼! 그 이야기가 뭐냐면요! 예전부터 정령의 눈물이 어떤 소리와 감정: Anyway! The story was that spirit tears have long been used to hold sounds and emotions.
strings.어떤 방식이 되는 건지는 잘 모르겠지만, 정령들이 제 노래 소리를 들었으: I don't know how it works, but the spirits heard me sing, so if they'd just shed a few tears...
strings.신을 따르는 정령의 것이니 어떻게든 될 것 같아요. 그러면 이곳에 있는: They serve the gods, so it might work somehow. We'd need to find the spirits here...
strings.제가 구해서 이리스에게 가져다 줄게요. 정확히는 이리스의 본체는 아니지만: I'll collect the tears and take them to Iris. Though technically, it won't be her main body.
Yes, I promise. And if I find any good sheet music in the future, I'll bring it to you.
Thank you. Truly... I'll leave it to you.
strings.얼마 전에 이리스를 봤지만, 그래도 얼어붙은 세계로 만나러 오는 건 정말: I saw you recently, Iris, but it feels like ages since I last came to the Frozen World to visit you.
Thank you for always believing in me and waiting.
I know you believe in me too. Thank you.
strings.아무것도 생각하지 않고, 그저 이리스를 위해 이 일이 끝나는 날을 생각할: I'll put everything else aside and think about the day this is all over, for your sake.
There are still so many thoughts I haven't sorted out.
strings.(이리스를 알게 되고, 여기까지 와서 많은 일을 겪고…, 그리고….): (Meeting Iris, coming all this way, everything that's happened... And...)
Oh, are you all right about what happened? What we saw at the estate...
I'm all right. It startled me at first, but I've accepted it.
I'm glad. Oh, I nearly forgot. Jenna asked me for something...
strings.(이리스에게 제나의 부탁으로 오게 된 걸 간단하게 설명한다.): (You briefly explain that you have come at Jenna's request.)
strings.그러면 저에게 정령의 눈물을 주시겠어요?: Then would you give me the spirit tears?
strings.(이리스가 정령의 눈물을 받은 채로 허공을 향해 손을 뻗는다. 정령의 눈: (Holding the spirit tears, Iris reaches toward the sky. The tears rise on the wind, then fall like rain.)
strings.이렇게 하면 얼어붙은 세계에서 제나의 목소리가 내릴 거예요. 내리는 동안: Now Jenna's voice will rain down over the Frozen World. We can hear her lovely singing while it falls.
strings.(이리스의 말처럼 제나의 목소리가 내리고 있네.): (Just as Iris said, Jenna's voice is falling with the rain.)
strings.(이리스가 눈을 감으며 제나의 목소리를 듣는다.): (Iris closes her eyes and listens to Jenna's voice.)
strings.(이리스, 울고 있는 건가? 아, 비인 건가?): (Is Iris crying? Or is that the rain?)
Please let Lady Gaia hear this song too.
strings.가이아 님이라고 하기는 그렇지만, 미뉴에트에게 말만 걸어주셔도 될 거 같: Not exactly Lady Gaia herself, but I think simply speaking to Minuet will do.
Oh, I see. All right, Iris. Thank you.
Yes, I'm Minuet! You only need to call once. What brings you...?
strings.감사드려요! 좋은 노래예요!: Thank you! What a lovely song!
I haven't said a word yet...
As soon as you spoke to me, I could tell.
strings.지스카드 님의 동생인 제나란 분이 가이아 님께 들려주고 싶어하던 노래에요: Jenna, Ziskad's younger sister, wanted Gaia to hear this song.
So this is what they mean by a treat for the ears.
You got to hear a song like that in person, %s. I'm jealous...
strings.저도 제나란 분 앞에서 그 노래를 듣고 싶어요. 하지만, 서로 아드리카와: I'd love to hear Jenna sing right in front of me. But I'm bound to Adrica, and she's bound to the Zisk Territory...
I suppose it can't be helped.
Though I'd be happy if Lady Gaia could hear her.
strings.제가 새로운 악보가 있다면 제나에게 들고 가서 오늘과 같은 방법으로 계속: Whenever I find new sheet music, I'll take it to Jenna and come visit you the same way I did today.
strings.(미묘하지만 미뉴에트의 표정이 바뀐 것 같다.): (Minuet's expression seems to change ever so slightly.)
strings.잘은 모르지만, 때가 되면 이쪽으로 오세요. 당장은 아니지만, 이곳으로: I'm not sure, but please come here when the time comes. Not right away, but I think you'll need to visit this place.
Lord Atkina and Lady Medea will soon release the seal.
I will. I'm good at waiting.
strings.그러면 나중에 만나요. 저는 잠깐 자야 할 거 같아요. 가이아 님께서 미: Then I'll see you later. I think I need a little sleep. Lady Gaia said I should find time to sleep about six hours a day too.
strings.가이아 님 닮아서 그런 건가?: Did she get that from Gaia?
Now I'm sleepy too. Maybe I'll go to nearby Tartaros and get some sleep... Yawn...
